name: Searing Strike
description:
The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell's duration, your weapon flares with white-hot intensity, and the attack deals an extra 1d6 fire damage to the target. The target must make a Fortitude saving throw or be set aflame. At the start of each of its turn, the target takes 1d6 fire damage. The spell ends if the target or a creature within 5 ft. of it uses the Help action to put out the flames, or if another effect occurs that would douse the flames.

**At Higher Levels.** When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the initial extra damage dealt by the attack increases by 1d6 for each slot above 1st.
